contract.disposition_rule: Each exact interval is either a qualified additive repair or a documented exception. This roster marks every key pending and does not claim that formal exception documentation or acceptance requirements are complete.
requirements: Reconstruct/authenticate all original intervals and whole targets.
Retain complete territorial competitors, ownerless foreign features, country-reference contrary evidence, complete physical inputs, and applicable historical evidence.
Account for all original cells; require stock native qualification, selected-owner-zero and conservation, independent exact-head review, and emitted selected output before credit.

evidence_limits: Original physical class land is preserved as the retained source claim for each held key; no per-key physical witness/current qualification is available in the cited retained inputs.
Center and full-cell results are geometric comparisons against retained source polygons, not legal/current source applicability, unique location authority, or package qualification.
For territorial keys, Ireland (IRL) country-reference contact is the exact retained native tuple association; it does not establish sovereignty or a current boundary.
The whole-target physical support and historical companion are target-level/context evidence, not per-key physical overlays.
All rows remain pending. No repair qualification, formal documented exception acceptance, credit, or denominator change is asserted.

interval_assignment.method: Held interval IDs enumerate exact runs in source RLE row order, beginning at held-001; each per-key row includes the exact [x_start,x_end_exclusive,owner,reason] interval run.
